mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalOrders, IFNULL(SUM(o.status = '已支付'), 0) AS paidOrders, IFNULL(SUM(IF(o.status = '已支付', o.total_price, 0)), 0) AS paidAmount, IFNULL(SUM(o.status = '未支付'), 0) AS unpaidOrders, IFNULL(SUM(IF(o.status = '未支付', o.total_price, 0)), 0) AS unpaidAmount, IFNULL(SUM(o.status IS NULL OR o.status NOT IN ('已支付', '未支付')), 0) AS otherStatusOrders, IFNULL(SUM( IS NULL), 0) AS undatedOrders, IFNULL(SUM(o.pay_time IS NULL AND o.last_confirm_time IS NULL AND o.status = '已支付'), 0) AS paidUndatedOrders, IFNULL(SUM(NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM showtimes st WHERE st.id = o.showtimes_id)), 0) AS lostShowtimeOrders, IFNULL(SUM(IF(o.status = '已支付' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM showtimes st WHERE st.id = o.showtimes_id), o.total_price, 0)), 0) AS lostShowtimeAmount, IFNULL(SUM(NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `user` u WHERE u.id = o.user_id)), 0) AS lostUserOrders, MIN(DATE()) AS minDate, MAX(DATE()) AS maxDate FROM `order` o

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, IFNULL(SUM(o.status = '已支付'), 0) AS paidOrders, IFNULL(SUM(IF(o.status = '已支付', o.total_price, 0)), 0) AS paidAmount, IFNULL(SUM(o.status = '未支付'), 0) AS unpaidOrders FROM `order` o WHERE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day

SELECT IFNULL(m.name, '（无法归类：场次已删除）') AS name, COUNT(o.id) AS orders, IFNULL(SUM(o.total_price), 0) AS amount FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN showtimes s ON s.id = o.showtimes_id LEFT JOIN movie m ON m.id = s.movie_id WHERE o.status = '已支付'
GROUP BY IFNULL(m.name, '（无法归类：场次已删除）') ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT IFNULL(c.name, '（无法归类：场次已删除）') AS name, COUNT(o.id) AS orders, IFNULL(SUM(o.total_price), 0) AS amount FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN showtimes s ON s.id = o.showtimes_id LEFT JOIN cinema c ON c.id = s.cinema_id WHERE o.status = '已支付'
GROUP BY IFNULL(c.name, '（无法归类：场次已删除）') ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalDetails, IFNULL(SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `order` o WHERE o.order_id = d.order_id)), 0) AS matchedDetails, COUNT(DISTINCT d.order_id) AS distinctOrderNumbers, IFNULL(SUM(d.price IS NULL), 0) AS nullPriceDetails FROM order_detail d
